; timezoneLocalePicker v0.1.0
; Adds the timezone and locale controls the stock UI does not have: the device
; ships UTC with LANG=en_US.UTF-8 and the only documented way to change either
; was an SSH mount-rw window (README.md:85-118). Settings > Display grows one
; panel that does both.
;
; Requires: qt-resource-rebuilder, qt-command-executor.
; State:    Values.tzLocZone / Values.tzLocLocale (QSettings category
;           "timezoneLocale"), both EMPTY by default.
;
; SOFT-DEPENDENCY CONTRACT. Empty means "not configured", and every code path
; below returns early on empty — so an unconfigured install issues no commands
; at all and a zone set by hand (timedatectl in a mount-rw window, or a shell
; script) is never overwritten. Other mods may read Values.tzLoc* the same way
; they read Values.pinSleepClockCadence, but must tolerate the properties being
; absent: without this qmd installed nothing declares them.
;
; WHY Qt.locale() NEEDS A PROCESS RESTART. xochitl imports no
; QLocale::setDefault symbol (checked against device/xochitl), so Qt.locale() is
; QLocale::system() — resolved once, at startup, from LC_ALL/LC_*/LANG in the
; process environment and cached. Nothing inside a running xochitl can move it.
; The stock "System language" cell (LanguageAndKeyboard.qml:80-86) only swaps
; QTranslators; it leaves Qt.locale() alone. So the locale arm sets LANG through
; a systemd drop-in and restarts the process, and the timezone arm — which goes
; through the /etc/localtime symlink, re-stat'd by glibc per conversion — does
; not restart anything.
;
; TWO MANDATORY CAPS ON THE LOCALE ARM, both live in the generated shell script
; so no QML-side race can skip them:
;   1. xovi injects its LD_PRELOAD through a TMPFS MOUNT over
;      /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d (scripts/deploy.sh:14-18). Our
;      drop-in shares that tmpfs. If the mount is gone — after a reboot before
;      xovi/start, or after any mount-utils package install, which does
;      `umount -R /etc` and never restores it (scripts/package.sh:96-100) — then
;      `systemctl restart xochitl` starts STOCK xochitl with every mod gone. So
;      test the MOUNT, not the path, and do nothing when it is absent.
;   2. systemd allows 4 xochitl starts per 10 minutes (StartLimitBurst);
;      exceeding it fails the unit and the recovery watchdog REBOOTS the device
;      (scripts/deploy.sh:79-81). The boot re-assert therefore fires only on a
;      normalised Qt.locale().name mismatch AND only once per boot, gated by a
;      /run marker (tmpfs, so it clears itself). `systemctl reset-failed`
;      precedes every restart.
; Qt.locale().name has the form "en_GB" — no ".UTF-8" suffix — while LANG needs
; the suffix, hence tzLocNorm(): compare stripped, write suffixed. Getting that
; comparison wrong is what turns the re-assert into a restart loop.
;
; The mount-rw /etc/locale.conf route (README.md:88-92) is deliberately NOT used
; from inside the mod: mount-utils' mount-rw would rip out the very tmpfs
; carrying the running process's own preload, and the recovery path (relaunching
; /home/root/xovi/start detached) cannot be tested from here.
;
; TIMEZONE APPLY has two arms because `timedatectl` talks to systemd-timedated
; over D-Bus and that context is unverified from a transient unit — the symlink
; the service would have written is the fallback. Both are writes into the /etc
; overlay, which is RAM-backed: everything here dies on reboot and is replayed
; by the Navigator re-assert below. Offsets in the labels are STANDARD time; the
; zones observe their own DST rules.
;
; NOT VERIFIED ON DEVICE (task #10): whether an empty `illustration` collapses
; the Selector's icon Column cleanly. ark's Selector is
; `ButtonBase { contentItem: Column { Icon { source: illustration } Row { radio
; + label } } }` (read out of device/xochitl), so an unset illustration should
; leave just the radio and label — the list entries depend on that. No
; illustration SVGs ship in v1 by owner ruling; if the icon does not collapse,
; two mod-drawn SVGs at bare filesystem paths are the fix (ark Icon takes a bare
; path, never file://).
;
; Also for task #10: both stock long lists size to their full content and set
; `interactive: false`, letting the outer ScrollArea do the scrolling
; (LanguageSelector.qml:13-14, SelectionComponent's GridView). The owner ruled a
; clipped six-row window instead, which necessarily leaves `interactive` at its
; default true — so an inner drag competes with Display.qml's outer Flickable.
; Check how that feels on the panel before changing anything.
;
; Also unverified: whether a live timezone change reaches the running process at
; all. v1 does not engineer for it — at most ONE xochitl restart per explicit
; user commit, and only on the locale arm.
;
; Keyboard navigation is deliberately not wired: neither this panel nor the
; sibling sleep-clock panel registers into Display.qml's navigationModel, whose
; indices are owned by the stock Repeater's navOffset counter.

; The store: Values is an engine-wide singleton, so the Display panel and the
; Navigator boot re-assert see the same values and share one copy of the script
; builders. Root-level function inserts are safe here; root-level ATTACHED
; handlers are not (other mods patch this file too).
AFFECT /qml/common/Values.qml
	IMPORT QtCore 6.5
	TRAVERSE Item
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			property alias tzLocZone: tzLocValueStore.tzLocZone
			property alias tzLocLocale: tzLocValueStore.tzLocLocale

			// "en_GB.UTF-8" and "en_GB@euro" both normalise to "en_GB", which
			// is the form Qt.locale().name returns. No regex literal: a bare
			// slash in a qmd INSERT is not worth the tokenizer risk.
			function tzLocNorm(v) {
				var s = "" + v;
				var cut = s.indexOf(".");
				if (cut < 0)
					cut = s.indexOf("@");
				if (cut >= 0)
					s = s.substring(0, cut);
				return s;
			}

			function tzLocZoneScript(tz) {
				return "timedatectl set-timezone '" + tz + "' 2>/dev/null"
					+ " || ln -sfn '/usr/share/zoneinfo/" + tz + "' /etc/localtime";
			}

			// bootAssert adds the once-per-boot marker check; an explicit user
			// commit must stay able to fire twice in one boot (pick a locale,
			// change your mind) and is already rate-limited by being a tap.
			// No ${} and no % anywhere in the string: systemd expands both in
			// transient-unit command lines.
			function tzLocLocaleScript(code, bootAssert) {
				return "grep -q ' /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d ' /proc/mounts || exit 0; "
					+ (bootAssert ? "[ -e /run/tzLoc-locale-asserted ] && exit 0; " : "")
					+ "touch /run/tzLoc-locale-asserted; "
					+ "mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d; "
					+ "printf '[Service]\\nEnvironment=LANG=" + code + ".UTF-8\\n'"
					+ " > /etc/systemd/system/xochitl.service.d/zz-tzLoc-locale.conf; "
					+ "systemctl daemon-reload; "
					+ "systemctl reset-failed xochitl 2>/dev/null; "
					+ "systemctl restart xochitl";
			}

			Item {
				id: tzLocValueStore
				// empty = not configured; see the soft-dependency contract in
				// the header. Never default these to a real zone or locale.
				property string tzLocZone: ""
				property string tzLocLocale: ""

				Settings {
					category: "timezoneLocale"
					property alias tzLocZone: tzLocValueStore.tzLocZone
					property alias tzLocLocale: tzLocValueStore.tzLocLocale
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; The Navigator is alive from startup even on the home screen, which makes it
; the boot re-assert host (same reason the sleep-clock cadence re-assert lives
; here). /etc is a volatile overlay: the zone silently reverts to UTC on every
; reboot, and the locale drop-in shares xovi's tmpfs, so both need replaying.
; Wrapped in an id'd Item — a root-level Component.onCompleted would collide
; with the other mods that patch this same root.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: tzLocBoot

				CommandExecutor {
					id: tzLocBootCmd
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					// Unconfigured installs issue nothing at all, so a zone set
					// by hand over SSH survives untouched.
					if (Values.tzLocZone.length > 0) {
						tzLocBootCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
							Values.tzLocZoneScript(Values.tzLocZone)]);
					}
					// The locale arm restarts xochitl, so it fires ONLY when the
					// running process actually has the wrong locale. After the
					// restart this compare is false and the /run marker is set,
					// which is what keeps a single boot from reaching
					// StartLimitBurst and tripping the reboot watchdog.
					if (Values.tzLocLocale.length > 0
						&& Values.tzLocNorm(Qt.locale().name) !== Values.tzLocNorm(Values.tzLocLocale)) {
						tzLocBootCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
							Values.tzLocLocaleScript(Values.tzLocLocale, true)]);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Display > "Time zone and locale": the Accessibility Readability row adapted
; for list length — a RowLayout of two autoExclusive ArkControls.Selectors acts
; as the value display AND as the switch for which list is shown underneath, and
; the list itself is Selector entries without illustrations. One of the two is
; always checked (an autoExclusive pair has no unchecked state), so the panel
; has no collapsed mode; showAttachment stays true.
; Panels must LOCATE BEFORE Repeater — a ColumnLayout child placed after it
; collides with the Repeater's re-inserted delegates. The sleep-clock panel uses
; the same slot; which of the two lands first follows exthome load order.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Display.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
	TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ScrollArea#flickable > Item#itemWrapper > ColumnLayout#column
		LOCATE BEFORE Repeater
		INSERT {
			ArkControls.Panel {
				id: tzLocPanel
				Layout.fillWidth: true
				label: qsTr("Time zone and locale")
				description: qsTr("The system clock runs on UTC until you pick a zone. The locale sets clock and date format, and applies after a restart.")

				// 1 = the zone list is showing, 2 = the locale list. Never 0:
				// the two Selectors are an autoExclusive pair.
				property int tzLocOpen: 1

				// ~40 zones, one per UTC offset in use plus the populous
				// duplicates. Offsets are STANDARD time. Full IANA enumeration
				// is out of scope for v1; anything missing is still reachable
				// with `timedatectl set-timezone` over SSH, which this mod
				// leaves alone as long as nothing is picked here.
				property var tzLocZones: [
					["Pacific/Midway", "Midway  UTC-11"],
					["Pacific/Honolulu", "Honolulu  UTC-10"],
					["America/Anchorage", "Anchorage  UTC-9"],
					["America/Los_Angeles", "Los Angeles  UTC-8"],
					["America/Denver", "Denver  UTC-7"],
					["America/Chicago", "Chicago  UTC-6"],
					["America/New_York", "New York  UTC-5"],
					["America/Halifax", "Halifax  UTC-4"],
					["America/St_Johns", "St John's  UTC-3:30"],
					["America/Sao_Paulo", "Sao Paulo  UTC-3"],
					["Atlantic/South_Georgia", "South Georgia  UTC-2"],
					["Atlantic/Azores", "Azores  UTC-1"],
					["UTC", "UTC"],
					["Europe/London", "London  UTC+0"],
					["Europe/Paris", "Paris  UTC+1"],
					["Europe/Berlin", "Berlin  UTC+1"],
					["Africa/Lagos", "Lagos  UTC+1"],
					["Europe/Kyiv", "Kyiv  UTC+2"],
					["Europe/Athens", "Athens  UTC+2"],
					["Africa/Cairo", "Cairo  UTC+2"],
					["Africa/Johannesburg", "Johannesburg  UTC+2"],
					["Europe/Moscow", "Moscow  UTC+3"],
					["Asia/Riyadh", "Riyadh  UTC+3"],
					["Asia/Tehran", "Tehran  UTC+3:30"],
					["Asia/Dubai", "Dubai  UTC+4"],
					["Asia/Kabul", "Kabul  UTC+4:30"],
					["Asia/Karachi", "Karachi  UTC+5"],
					["Asia/Kolkata", "Kolkata  UTC+5:30"],
					["Asia/Kathmandu", "Kathmandu  UTC+5:45"],
					["Asia/Dhaka", "Dhaka  UTC+6"],
					["Asia/Yangon", "Yangon  UTC+6:30"],
					["Asia/Bangkok", "Bangkok  UTC+7"],
					["Asia/Shanghai", "Shanghai  UTC+8"],
					["Asia/Singapore", "Singapore  UTC+8"],
					["Australia/Perth", "Perth  UTC+8"],
					["Asia/Tokyo", "Tokyo  UTC+9"],
					["Asia/Seoul", "Seoul  UTC+9"],
					["Australia/Adelaide", "Adelaide  UTC+9:30"],
					["Australia/Sydney", "Sydney  UTC+10"],
					["Pacific/Noumea", "Noumea  UTC+11"],
					["Pacific/Auckland", "Auckland  UTC+12"],
					["Pacific/Apia", "Apia  UTC+13"]
				]

				// Qt carries its own CLDR data, so QLocale resolves any of these
				// names whether or not glibc has the locale archive installed —
				// a missing archive only leaves xochitl's C code in the C
				// locale. Labels stay ASCII: the qmd toolchain is only ever
				// exercised on ASCII sources.
				property var tzLocLocales: [
					["en_US", "English (United States)"],
					["en_GB", "English (United Kingdom)"],
					["en_AU", "English (Australia)"],
					["en_CA", "English (Canada)"],
					["en_IE", "English (Ireland)"],
					["de_DE", "German (Germany)"],
					["fr_FR", "French (France)"],
					["es_ES", "Spanish (Spain)"],
					["it_IT", "Italian (Italy)"],
					["nl_NL", "Dutch (Netherlands)"],
					["pt_BR", "Portuguese (Brazil)"],
					["pt_PT", "Portuguese (Portugal)"],
					["sv_SE", "Swedish (Sweden)"],
					["nb_NO", "Norwegian (Norway)"],
					["da_DK", "Danish (Denmark)"],
					["fi_FI", "Finnish (Finland)"],
					["pl_PL", "Polish (Poland)"],
					["cs_CZ", "Czech (Czechia)"],
					["uk_UA", "Ukrainian (Ukraine)"],
					["ru_RU", "Russian (Russia)"],
					["ja_JP", "Japanese (Japan)"],
					["zh_CN", "Chinese (China)"],
					["ko_KR", "Korean (South Korea)"]
				]

				CommandExecutor {
					id: tzLocCmd
				}

				// Persist first, then apply: the persisted value is what the
				// Navigator replays after the next reboot, and it must survive
				// even if the command below is a no-op.
				function tzLocCommitZone(tz) {
					Values.tzLocZone = tz;
					tzLocCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
						Values.tzLocZoneScript(tz)]);
				}

				// This is the ONE restart the user gets per commit. It is a
				// no-op whenever xovi's drop-in tmpfs is missing, in which case
				// the stored value still applies at the next properly-started
				// boot.
				function tzLocCommitLocale(code) {
					Values.tzLocLocale = code;
					tzLocCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
						Values.tzLocLocaleScript(code, false)]);
				}

				showAttachment: true
				attachment: ColumnLayout {
					Layout.fillWidth: true
					spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.large

					RowLayout {
						Layout.fillWidth: true
						spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.large

						ArkControls.Selector {
							id: tzLocZoneSelector
							Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
							objectName: "tzLocZoneSelector"
							text: Values.tzLocZone.length > 0 ? Values.tzLocZone : qsTr("Time zone")
							checkable: true
							autoExclusive: true
							checked: tzLocPanel.tzLocOpen === 1
							onClicked: tzLocPanel.tzLocOpen = 1
						}

						ArkControls.Selector {
							id: tzLocLocaleSelector
							Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
							objectName: "tzLocLocaleSelector"
							text: Values.tzLocLocale.length > 0 ? Values.tzLocLocale : qsTr("Locale")
							checkable: true
							autoExclusive: true
							checked: tzLocPanel.tzLocOpen === 2
							onClicked: tzLocPanel.tzLocOpen = 2
						}
					}

					// Height ruler. The Selector's height depends on ark tokens
					// no diff can read AND on whether an empty illustration
					// collapses its icon Column (task #10), so measure one real
					// control. It must NOT be measured off the ListView's own
					// contentHeight: a virtualised view instantiates only the
					// delegates inside its viewport, so a height derived from
					// contentHeight starts at 0, instantiates nothing, and
					// settles at 0 forever — count stays 42 the whole time, so
					// a count guard does not catch it. An invisible child is
					// skipped by QQuickLayout but still has an implicitHeight.
					// Fallback if this measures oddly:
					// ArkTokens.Style.variable.controlsHeight.small, which is
					// what SelectionComponent uses as its cellHeight.
					ArkControls.Selector {
						id: tzLocRuler
						visible: false
						text: "Ag"
					}

					ListView {
						id: tzLocList
						Layout.fillWidth: true
						Layout.preferredHeight: 6 * tzLocRuler.implicitHeight
						clip: true
						model: tzLocPanel.tzLocOpen === 2 ? tzLocPanel.tzLocLocales
							: tzLocPanel.tzLocZones

						delegate: ArkControls.Selector {
							required property var modelData

							width: tzLocList.width
							text: modelData[1]
							checkable: true
							autoExclusive: true
							checked: tzLocPanel.tzLocOpen === 2
								? Values.tzLocLocale === modelData[0]
								: Values.tzLocZone === modelData[0]
							onClicked: {
								if (tzLocPanel.tzLocOpen === 2)
									tzLocPanel.tzLocCommitLocale(modelData[0]);
								else
									tzLocPanel.tzLocCommitZone(modelData[0]);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
